incidents.name: MixedSwapRouter unauthenticated algebraSwapCallback
incidents.notes: MixedSwapRouter.algebraSwapCallback() trusted the caller-supplied SwapCallbackData payer and pool without verifying that msg.sender was a real Algebra pool, so a direct call let the attacker pull WINR from any wallet that had approved the router.

sources.ref: onchain review: router 0x58637aaac44e2a2f190d9e1976e236d86d691542 created 2024-05-27T15:28:12Z by 0xd47e10859849f4929da3559451338a1c56d29584, not the attack-tx sender 0xfeef112831cc8f790abe71b4b196c220ee26ecf3; no EIP-1967 events, 3.7 days old. The PoC targets an approving wallet 0xb6d566c4d645ab640fc6Ac362f233dCFB5621f7C. PoC header reports at least 10,000 USD of WINR taken. Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim sets no EIP-1967 implementation or beacon slot and its runtime is byte-identical at the creation block 215606657 and the incident block 216881056; its single DELEGATECALL is OpenZeppelin AddressUpgradeable.functionDelegateCall on the UUPS upgradeToAndCall path, which the onlyProxy/__self check makes unreachable on this directly deployed contract, so no external code can be substituted and deployment is exact.
